Sam (Infra PM): quick follow-up from today's all-hands: customers asked what the APAC 'safety net' is if warm nodes drop during the holiday spike. is that just preemptibles or do we have an intermediate reserve? cc @Priyanka

Priyanka (VP Infra): short answer: safety net = warm-reserve + preemptible pools. sequence is regional warm -> warm-reserve (paid or credits) -> regional preempt -> remote. warm-reserve is a small buffer we can allocate for customers with credits or pilot SLAs.

Leo (SRE): ops details: we detect region volatility when `preempt_rate > 0.2` over 60s. when that fires we try warm-reserve allocations for premium routes for up to 10 minutes, then allow regional preempt if reserve exhausted.

Tess (Support): can we get a one-line explanation for customers when they see a brief spike? non-technical please.

Priyanka (VP Infra): suggested: "We keep a small regional buffer to protect latency-sensitive traffic during short spikes; if that fills we briefly use lower-cost regional capacity to keep requests flowing."

ops-bot: deploy queued: autoscaler/v2 -> staging at 2024-01-12T12:00:00Z. monitor: warm-reserve-util, preempt-rate.

Sam (Infra PM): action items: 1) Leo to post preempt dashboard link 2) Priyanka to share warm-reserve FAQ line for CS 3) Sam to add a short paragraph to the all-hands follow-up doc. target: EOD Thu.
